```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(ggh4x)
```

```{r}
ds_sbs192 <- data.table::fread("/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/matGen/ds_filtered/output/SBS/UC_AA.SBS288.all") %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::filter(!grepl(pattern = "N:", x = MutationType))

## SBS192 count matrix per sample
ds_sbs192_count <- ds_sbs192 %>% remove_rownames() %>% column_to_rownames(var = "MutationType") %>%
  t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Samples") %>%
  mutate(type = case_when(grepl(pattern = "Blood", x = Samples) ~ "_Blood",
                          grepl(pattern = "Urine", x = Samples) ~ "_Urine",
                          TRUE ~ "Other"),
         group = paste0("UC", as.numeric(str_extract(Samples, "\\d+"))),
         newName = paste0(group, type)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(type != "Other") %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "newName") %>%
  dplyr::select(-Samples, -type, -group) %>% 
  t() %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "MutationType")

## Convert SBS192 to SBS6 count matrix per sample while retaining strand bias information
ds_sbs192_collapsed_sbs6 <- ds_sbs192_count %>%
  mutate(type = gsub(pattern = ".*\\[", replacement = "", x = MutationType),
         type = gsub(pattern = "\\].*", replacement = "", x = type),
         strand = gsub(pattern = "\\:.*", replacement = "", x = MutationType)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-MutationType) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(strand, type) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), sum)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() #%>%
  # mutate(across(where(is.numeric),
  #               ~ .x / sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)))

## Factor order
ds_sbs192_collapsed_sbs6$strand <- factor(x = ds_sbs192_collapsed_sbs6$strand, levels = rev(c("T", "U")))
ds_sbs192_collapsed_sbs6$type <- factor(x = ds_sbs192_collapsed_sbs6$type,
                                         levels = rev(c("C>A", "C>G", "C>T", "T>A", "T>C", "T>G")))
```

SBS96 dual label
```{r}
mut.order <- c("C>A", "C>G", "C>T", "T>A", "T>C", "T>G")

mut.color <- c('deepskyblue','black','red','lightgrey','yellowgreen','pink')
names(mut.color) <- mut.order

plotSBS6dual <- function(id) {
  sampname <- as.character(id)
  samp_col <- which(names(ds_sbs192_collapsed_sbs6) == sampname)
  df1 <- data.frame(MutationType = ds_sbs192_collapsed_sbs6$type, 
                    strand = ds_sbs192_collapsed_sbs6$strand,
                    value = ds_sbs192_collapsed_sbs6[,samp_col]) %>%
    'colnames<-' (c("MutationType", "strand", "value"))
  df1$propvalue <- df1$value / sum(df1$value)
  df1$MutationType <- factor(x = df1$MutationType, levels = mut.order)
  df1$strand <- factor(x = df1$strand, levels = c("U", "T"))
  
  df1$strandbias <- unlist(parallel::mclapply(X = as.list(unique(df1$MutationType)), FUN = function(x) {
    t <- df1 %>% dplyr::filter(MutationType %in% all_of(x),
                               strand == "T") %>%
      pull(value)
    u <- df1 %>% dplyr::filter(MutationType %in% all_of(x),
                               strand == "U") %>% 
      pull(value)
    if(t == 0 & u == 0) {
      t <- 1
      u <- 1
      pval <- -log10(1)
      } else {
        pval <- -log10(binom.test(x = t, n = t+u, p = 0.5, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value)
        }
    return(pval)
    }, mc.cores = 10))
  
  pval_df <- df1 %>% dplyr::select(MutationType, strandbias) %>% distinct()
  pval_df$stars <- dplyr::case_when(pval_df$strandbias >= 4 ~ "****",
                                    pval_df$strandbias >= 3 ~ "***",
                                    pval_df$strandbias >= 2 ~ "**",
                                    pval_df$strandbias >= 1.30103 ~ "*",
                                    TRUE ~ "")
  
  # scaling factor between SBS counts and -log10(p)
  scale_factor <- max(df1$propvalue) / max(pval_df$strandbias)
  
  p1 <- ggplot(df1, aes(x = MutationType, y = propvalue, fill = MutationType)) +
    geom_bar(aes(group = strand),
             stat = "identity", 
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
             width = 0.7,
             color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = mut.color) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("C>A" = "N T",
        "C>G" = "N T",
        "C>T" = "N T",
        "T>A" = "N T",
        "T>C" = "N T",
        "T>G" = "N T")) +
    geom_line(data = pval_df,
              aes(x = MutationType, y = strandbias * scale_factor, group = 1),
              linetype = "dashed",
              linewidth = 0.3,
              color = "grey30") +
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = "SBS Contribution (%)",
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.125)),
      sec.axis = sec_axis(
        ~ . / scale_factor,
        name = expression("-log"[10]*"(p)")
      )) +
    geom_text(data = subset(pval_df, stars != ""),
              aes(x = MutationType, y = strandbias * scale_factor, 
                  label = stars),
              vjust = 0, size = 1.8, 
              color = "firebrick3") +
    ggtitle(sampname) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 6, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(t=0, b=0)),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 6),
          axis.title.x =  element_blank(),
          legend.position = "none")
  return(p1)
}

p1 <- plotSBS6dual(id = "UC7_Blood")
p2 <- plotSBS6dual(id = "UC14_Blood")
p3 <- plotSBS6dual(id = "UC14_Urine")
p4 <- plotSBS6dual(id = "UC18_Blood")
p5 <- plotSBS6dual(id = "UC18_Urine")
p6 <- plotSBS6dual(id = "UC19_Blood")
p7 <- plotSBS6dual(id = "UC19_Urine")
p8 <- plotSBS6dual(id = "UC34_Blood")
```
